fact_english: Manila paper and manila envelopes are named after Manila hemp, or abaca, the Philippine fibre the paper was originally made from.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang manila envelope at manila paper, ipinangalan sa manila hemp, ang abaka natin, na dati nitong pinagmulan!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Kaya pala kulay-abaka. Akala ko pagod lang ang papel.
